scope: Ingredient notes on existing HE/EN ingredient hub cards. No numeric dish values, new pages, metadata or index-policy changes.
owner_override: Healthy-food information is a cross-site editorial layer, not a medical service or a generic badge. Preserve current index policy; the older seed registry's default noindex does not authorize new noindex changes.

coverage.homepage: Make nutritious food choices discoverable with real ingredient-led imagery and concise wording; link to existing relevant content rather than repeat health keywords everywhere.
coverage.ingredient: One specific useful nutrition note, matched to the ingredient and its raw/cooked state, with a supporting source.
coverage.dish: Explain relevant ingredients, preparation and portion context from the actual recipe. Do not transfer an ingredient's nutrient concentration to the whole serving.
coverage.cuisine_and_technique: Discuss practical preparation choices and meal balance without labelling an entire cuisine healthy or unhealthy.
coverage.group_order: Help customers discuss vegetables, legumes, whole grains and preparation preferences without promising substitutions or service capabilities that are not offered.
coverage.business_and_location: Surface supported menu choices through related dishes. Geographic proximity or a business category is not evidence of a health benefit.

sitewide_acceptance.balanced_evidence: Include relevant portion size, sodium, added sugar, saturated fat and preparation effects alongside positive properties. Scientific does not mean finding a positive health claim for every food.
sitewide_acceptance.public_style: Short, appetising, natural Israeli Hebrew. No internal review status, missing-data notices, disease promises or automatic healthy badges.
sitewide_acceptance.structured_data: Publish nutrient values only when supported by the matching visible content and actual food or recipe. No hidden invented nutrition properties for SEO.
sitewide_acceptance.status: Cross-site acceptance criteria recorded, not a claim that every template is implemented. Existing three live ingredient notes remain the verified coverage.

claims.support: MOH identifies chickpeas as pulses containing protein and dietary fibre and suggests soups, salads and stews.
claims.boundary: A cooked chickpea ingredient is not the composition of a restaurant hummus serving.

claims.support: MOH includes tahini in daily plant-fat choices.
claims.boundary: Paste and diluted sauce differ; no calcium, protein or calorie figure is asserted for this SKU.

claims.support: WHO identifies olive oil among unsaturated-fat sources and prefers unsaturated to saturated fats.
claims.boundary: No superiority claim, disease prevention promise or unlimited-intake suggestion.
